placement_requirement: TXL rows must be pinned: 4_cts census shows GPL places row 0 at the encoder and the last row at the pad, so all wire falls on one hop. The two new rows must sit at 1/3 and 2/3 of the row0->last-row span (relay_mid class; relay_mid.tcl needs fixed endpoints, so row 0 and the last row or a dedicated hook are required).

hop_estimate_after_staging_ps.method: worst r0->q span from 4_cts census / 3 x 0.49 ps/um (t2 G2 repaired-wire figure) + 60 ck-q+setup; budget 833 with W 180 as carried in today's SDC, skew = worst launch-capture on those bits
